summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V., a Dutch foreign private issuer listed on Euronext Amsterdam, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a home-country stock exchange announcement dated September 10, 2026. It details open-market purchases of 306,030 ordinary shares on September 9, 2026 at an average price of EUR 16.75604, totaling EUR 5,127,851, across Euronext, CBOE, DXE and Turquoise Europe. Cumulative acquisitions since August 18, 2026 reached 5,401,973 shares, completing a tranche covering long-term incentive plan obligations. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms apply; no arbitrage angle exists beyond routine buyback-related supply absorption.
